title: Attacker url observed in the wild: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/president32/uploader2/m… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A URL hosting an attacker payload related to CVE-2017-9841 was observed in the wild by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-05. The URL was seen three times and is associated with the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer). The attacker infrastructure was identified in the United Arab Emirates (AE). This URL is used for tool download, callback, or exploitation targeting. Defenders are advised to block and monitor this URL and search their proxy, web, and WAF logs for any requests to it.
